title: Partition-time consistency
description:
Two replicas lose connectivity. Explain why a request cannot guarantee both linearizable consistency and availability during the partition. Choose a policy for bank balances versus a public catalog.

Write a structured explanation. This is a transparent keyword rubric, not an AI architect or proof of a sound design. Check every tradeoff yourself; a rubric pass demonstrates coverage only.

reference.text:
Two replicas lose connectivity. Explain why a request cannot guarantee both linearizable consistency and availability during the partition. Choose a policy for bank balances versus a public catalog.
CAP concerns behavior during a partition, not a free choice of any two properties in all operating conditions. Bank and catalog operations may choose different policies.
